title: 開車相關
description: 駕駛與車輛相關的日常用語

sentences.en: The check engine light on my dashboard, which has been blinking intermittently for the past week, finally stayed on permanently this morning during my commute.
sentences.zh: 儀表板上的引擎檢查燈過去一週斷斷續續閃爍，今天早上通勤時終於常亮不滅了。

sentences.en: Before merging onto the highway, make sure you accelerate to match the speed of traffic in the right lane so that other drivers do not have to brake suddenly.
sentences.zh: 匯入高速公路前，確保加速到與右車道車流相同的速度，這樣其他駕駛不必突然煞車。

sentences.en: The mechanic at the auto shop recommended replacing all four tires before winter because the tread depth has worn down below the safe minimum threshold.
sentences.zh: 汽車修理廠的技師建議在冬天前更換全部四條輪胎，因為胎紋深度已磨損到安全最低標準以下。

sentences.en: I would have arrived on time if the road construction ahead, which reduced three lanes to one, had not caused a forty-minute backup during rush hour.
sentences.zh: 如果前方的道路施工——把三線道縮減為一線——沒有在尖峰時段造成四十分鐘的回堵，我就會準時到達。

sentences.en: Could you remind me where we parked the car, because this multi-story garage with its identical-looking levels is extremely confusing to navigate without a reference point?
sentences.zh: 你能提醒我我們把車停在哪裡嗎？因為這個每層看起來都一樣的多層停車場，沒有參考點真的很難找。

sentences.en: The navigation system keeps recalculating the route, which suggests that the road I was planning to take has either been closed or is experiencing severe congestion.
sentences.zh: 導航系統一直在重新計算路線，這表示我原本打算走的那條路可能被封閉或正在嚴重塞車。

sentences.en: When driving in heavy rain, it is essential to reduce your speed and increase the following distance to at least double what you would normally maintain in dry conditions.
sentences.zh: 在大雨中駕駛時，必須降低速度並將跟車距離增加到乾燥路面正常距離的至少兩倍。

sentences.en: The parallel parking space between those two SUVs looks barely big enough for my compact sedan, but I will attempt it since there are no other spots available nearby.
sentences.zh: 那兩台休旅車之間的路邊停車位看起來勉強能容納我的小轎車，但既然附近沒有其他車位，我就試試看。

sentences.en: According to the dashboard display, the fuel tank is nearly empty, so we should find a gas station before getting on the expressway where stations are few and far between.
sentences.zh: 根據儀表板顯示，油箱快空了，所以我們應該在上高速公路前找個加油站，因為高速公路上的加油站很少。

sentences.en: The insurance company requires me to submit photos of the damage from multiple angles, along with a copy of the police report filed at the scene of the accident.
sentences.zh: 保險公司要求我提交多個角度的損壞照片，以及在事故現場報案的警方報告副本。

sentences.en: Having just obtained my driver's license last month after failing the road test twice, I am still quite nervous about driving in heavy traffic or on unfamiliar highways.
sentences.zh: 上個月在路考失敗兩次後終於拿到駕照，我在繁忙車流或不熟悉的高速公路上開車仍然很緊張。

sentences.en: The toll booth operator informed me that the electronic pass I purchased online should be attached to the upper corner of the windshield for the scanner to read properly.
sentences.zh: 收費站人員告訴我，網路上購買的電子通行證應該貼在擋風玻璃的上角，掃描器才能正確讀取。

sentences.en: I noticed a strange rattling noise coming from underneath the car whenever I drive over speed bumps, which might indicate a problem with the suspension system.
sentences.zh: 我注意到每次開過減速丘時，車底都會傳來奇怪的嘎嘎聲，這可能表示懸吊系統有問題。

sentences.en: The rental car company charges an additional fee for drivers under twenty-five, which they justify by citing higher accident statistics for that age group.
sentences.zh: 租車公司對二十五歲以下的駕駛收取額外費用，他們以該年齡層較高的事故統計數據為依據。

sentences.en: Since the school zone speed limit drops to twenty miles per hour during pickup and drop-off times, you need to be especially careful between three and four in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 由於學區速限在接送時段降為每小時二十英里，下午三點到四點之間需要特別小心。

sentences.en: The detour sign posted at the intersection indicates that all eastbound traffic must use the alternative route through the industrial district until bridge repairs are completed.
sentences.zh: 路口設置的改道標誌指出，所有東向車流必須使用經過工業區的替代路線，直到橋梁修復完成。

sentences.en: Would you mind checking the tire pressure for me while I go inside to pay, because the low-pressure warning indicator has been on since yesterday morning?
sentences.zh: 你介意幫我檢查一下胎壓嗎？我進去付錢的時候，因為胎壓不足的警示燈從昨天早上就亮著了。

sentences.en: The highway patrol officer who pulled me over explained that I had been driving fifteen miles per hour above the posted speed limit without apparently realizing it.
sentences.zh: 攔下我的高速公路巡邏警察解釋說，我在顯然沒有意識到的情況下超過公告速限每小時十五英里。

sentences.en: Rather than paying for expensive downtown parking, which can cost up to thirty dollars per hour, many commuters choose to park at suburban stations and take the train.
sentences.zh: 與其付昂貴的市中心停車費——每小時可高達三十美元——許多通勤者選擇把車停在郊區車站再搭火車。

sentences.en: The car's blind spot monitoring system alerted me just in time to avoid changing lanes into a motorcycle that I had completely failed to notice in my side mirror.
sentences.zh: 車子的盲點偵測系統及時提醒我，避免我變換車道撞上一台我完全沒在後照鏡注意到的摩托車。

sentences.en: After waiting in the drive-through line for twenty minutes without moving, I finally decided to park the car and go inside to order my food directly at the counter.
sentences.zh: 在得來速排隊等了二十分鐘動都沒動之後，我終於決定停好車進去直接在櫃台點餐。

sentences.en: The headlights on this rental car seem much dimmer than what I am used to, which makes driving on these poorly lit rural roads at night feel particularly dangerous.
sentences.zh: 這台租車的頭燈似乎比我習慣的暗很多，在這些照明不佳的鄉間道路上夜間駕駛感覺特別危險。

sentences.en: I strongly recommend getting winter tires installed before December because the mountain passes on our usual route become extremely icy and treacherous during that season.
sentences.zh: 我強烈建議在十二月前安裝雪胎，因為我們常走路線上的山口在那個季節會變得極度結冰且危險。

sentences.en: The valet parking attendant handed me a ticket and assured me that my car would be brought to the front entrance within five minutes of my calling the service number.
sentences.zh: 代客泊車服務員給了我一張票，並保證我打服務電話後五分鐘內會把車送到正門口。

sentences.en: Given that the battery in my car is already four years old and winter temperatures significantly reduce its capacity, I should probably have it tested before the cold weather arrives.
sentences.zh: 考慮到我車上的電池已經用了四年，而且冬季低溫會大幅降低其容量，我或許應該在寒冷天氣來臨前先去檢測。

sentences.en: The roundabout at this five-way intersection confused me so much that I ended up circling it three times before finally figuring out which exit led to the highway.
sentences.zh: 這個五岔路口的圓環把我搞得很混亂，我繞了三圈才終於搞清楚哪個出口通往高速公路。

sentences.en: If the oil change warning light comes on while you are driving, it does not mean you need to pull over immediately, but you should schedule a service appointment within the week.
sentences.zh: 如果開車時換油警示燈亮起，不代表你需要立即停車，但應該在一週內預約保養。

sentences.en: The carpool lane, which requires at least two occupants per vehicle during peak hours, allows qualifying drivers to bypass the congestion that builds up in the regular lanes.
sentences.zh: 共乘車道在尖峰時段要求每輛車至少兩人，讓符合資格的駕駛可以避開一般車道的塞車。

sentences.en: My windshield wipers have been leaving streaks across the glass, making it nearly impossible to see clearly in the rain, so I need to replace the rubber blades as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 我的雨刷一直在玻璃上留下水痕，讓我在雨中幾乎看不清楚，所以需要盡快更換橡膠刮片。

sentences.en: The electric vehicle charging station at the mall, which offers both fast charging and standard options, was fully occupied when I arrived, forcing me to wait an extra thirty minutes.
sentences.zh: 商場的電動車充電站提供快充和標準充電兩種選項，但我到的時候全部佔滿了，迫使我多等了三十分鐘。
